The cat's eyes are squeezed shut in a smile, and its mouth is wide open as if cheering. It stands between two vertical stacks of colorful gift boxes; the left stack includes yellow, blue, and pink boxes, while the right stack features green and red boxes. Above the character, the words 'HAPPY 10th BIRTHDAY' are written in bold, yellow bubble letters with a white outline. The lighting is flat and uniform against a stark white background. (2) As the video continues, the cat performs a rhythmic dance, swaying its body from left to right while swinging its stubby paws up and down in synchronization with the beat. The gift boxes remain static on either side, providing a frame for the movement. The copyright text '©MOCHI DAD/THAT FISH CORP.' remains fixed at the bottom center of the frame in small black font. The visual pace is steady and repetitive, maintaining a consistent high-energy, celebratory mood through the character's enthusiastic physical motions.
